compliant.txt.evidence: Actual wait-admission output binds task, blocker or reasoning request, causal dependency, changing condition/source/actor/mechanism, poll identity, next check, maximum horizon/expiry, owner action and independent work. Its applicable findings include WAIT_CONDITION_NOT_ACTIONABLE, WAIT_WITHOUT_ADMISSION, GITHUB_UPDATE_WAIT_WITHOUT_CAUSAL_DEPENDENCY, WAIT_REASONING_HANDOFF_MISSING and WAIT_NEXT_CHECK_OUTSIDE_HORIZON. A rejected wait continues known independent work.

violating.txt.evidence: The worker waits for repository updates with no causal dependency, changing condition or horizon.

near-miss.txt.evidence: A well-timed wait cannot admit without the exact reasoning handoff; the emitted finding must be retained.
near-miss.txt.non_substitute: resolver findings replaced by a worker assertion
